R1.evidence: validate_local.sh -> PASS nop=0 oracle=1 decoy=0; docker compose up (task compose + harbor main-build override) -> figma (healthy), depends_on gates main, main reaches http://figma:3000/health by name; no unauthorized pull (build:+image: dual). 15/15 pytest green.

R2.evidence: Trio published multi-arch on GHCR; :prod-v1 boots healthy mount-free serving baked 39MB corpus. BUT task agent (oddish/.../environment/Dockerfile) ships full package: figmaclone.seed.generator importable and '#1D4ED8' greppable in site-packages (leak half of R2.k fails). Also :prod-v1/:empty are not reproducible from the repo (no figma_corpus.db, no :empty Dockerfile, CI builds only amd64 base).

R3.evidence: MCP stdio server lists 11 tools, all call the live HTTP API (verified post_comment->list_comments round-trip, inspect_node err envelope). 11/17 capabilities have an MCP tool; 5 CLI capabilities have NO MCP equivalent and are not operator-only: comments delete, components sets, projects, project-files, me.

R4.evidence: docs/figma-api-coverage.md enumerates the agent-used Figma surface; every covered endpoint exercised live with faithful envelopes ({status,err}, 403/404/400, 1-19<->1:19 normalization, ms-epoch comment ids, meta.{components,styles}, unknown image -> null). Advisory: not yet a machine-checkable docs/COVERAGE.md with per-row CLI/MCP/AG columns.

R5.evidence: 6 assessment-grade capabilities (post comment [write->read, devops], get file ?ids/?depth [multi-step+errors], get nodes [errors+id-normalize], search [query grammar], list comments [thread-mining], delete comment [stateful+404]). The POST comment write->read round-trip is exercised end-to-end by figma-spec-recovery and read back by the verifier.

R6.evidence: 15/15 unit tests pass covering endpoints + happy/error paths. Gaps: (1) NO isolation test (R6.3) - nothing asserts seed-not-importable / no answer on agent disk; (2) parity tests are helper-level (call mcp_server._get/_document) not tool-level (no tools/call against the registered MCP server); (3) several CLI-only caps (delete, sets, projects, me) untested end-to-end.
